name: Reply in Channel
description: Discord-style Reply in Channel - reply to any message inline with a blockquote of the original

settings.help_text: When true (default), the first reply typed into the thread of a /ric channel post is rejected before it is saved, with a link to the original thread, and /ric is refused inside such threads. Echo threads that already have replies are never sealed. Set false to restore pre-1.1.0 behavior.
